exposure: Social marketing campaign promoting normal childbirth
outcome: Choice of birth method (vaginal vs. cesarean)
cohort: 350 first-time pregnant women planning a cesarean birth without medical indications in Iran
finding: The social marketing campaign was successful, with 35.6% of the campaign group choosing vaginal birth compared to 13.5% in the control group.
mod_finding: The social marketing campaign successfully increased the proportion of women who chose vaginal birth.
